schema:
CREATE TABLE users (
  id integer PRIMARY KEY,
  email text NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  full_name text,
  status text CHECK (status IN ('active','invited','disabled')),
  created_at timestamp
);
CREATE TABLE notes (
  id integer PRIMARY KEY,
  user_id integer NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
  title varchar(200) NOT NULL,
  body text,
  pinned boolean
);
